sentences.en: Above the clouds, the pilot felt a freedom without boundaries.
sentences.zh: 在云层之上，飞行员感受到了无边界的自由。

sentences.en: Cats are very affectionate to people who respect their boundaries.
sentences.zh: 猫对尊重它们界限的人非常亲昵。

sentences.en: There are no longer boundaries between pure and applied mathematics.
sentences.zh: 纯数学和应用数学之间的界线已经不再存在了。

senses.zh: 分界线，边界；界限，范围；（板球）击球超过边界线得分

mnemonic: 词根记忆：bound（界限）+ary（表地点）→分界线，边界
